subject.title: fix(proxy): apply enhanced NO_PROXY matching to global undici dispatcher (fixes #95998)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off `proxy.enhancedNoProxy` mode that lets the global Undici EnvHttpProxyAgent bypass the operator proxy for OpenClaw-enhanced NO_PROXY matches?
rationale: The code path is a plausible fix for the linked proxy-routing regression, but allowing configured destinations to bypass a process-wide egress proxy is a product/security boundary choice that automation should not approve silently.

options.title: Accept after docs correction
options.body: Keep the default-off config surface, require accurate ambient EnvHttpProxyAgent docs/schema wording, and let proxy/security owners approve the egress-boundary tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Close or rework the PR toward existing Undici behavior or a narrower issue-specific mitigation without adding a process-wide bypass mode.

options.title: Defer to proxy policy design
options.body: Pause this PR and define the permanent proxy and NO_PROXY policy in a separate owner-approved design item before changing global dispatcher behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs correction
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off config surface, require accurate ambient EnvHttpProxyAgent docs/schema wording, and let proxy/security owners approve the egress-boundary tradeoff before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent proxy helper and NO_PROXY history makes this the best observed routing owner for the product/security boundary decision.
